caseName: Chicago Welfare Rights Organization v. Edelman
caseNameFull: Chicago Welfare Rights Organization v. Edelman, Director, Department of Public Aid of Illinois

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ill. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
